title: Marlborough School Opening Meetings Guest Lecture on AI and Ethics
snippet: Dr. Safiya Noble, the David O. Sears Presidential Endowed Chair of Social Sciences at UCLA, shared her expertise on algorithmic bias and the intersection of AI and ethics. In conversation with school leaders, Dr. Noble facilitated a discussion on navigating AI with young people and in education.

title: Guiding AI Use in Your Course in Fall 2026: What's Changed, and What Can Instructors Do?
snippet: Tufts University's Center for the Enhancement of Learning and Teaching published a guide for instructors on implementing the university's new Generative AI Usage Guidelines. The guide emphasizes designing assignments that make learning visible rather than relying on unreliable AI detectors.
match_reason: websearch (blog_post) — This provides precedent-setting pedagogical guidance and policy implementation by a peer R1 university (Tufts) that other universities would weigh.

title: How Brown University is Navigating the Rise of Generative AI Use in the Classroom
snippet: Brown University's Generative AI in Teaching and Learning (GAITL) Phase 2 Committee released sample generative AI syllabus statements and guidelines to help faculty clarify expectations. The initiative aims to balance AI innovation with academic integrity and critical thinking preservation.
match_reason: websearch (news_article) — This represents a precedent-setting governance and teaching guidelines release by a peer R1 university (Brown) that informs UC-level decisions.

title: California Assembly Bill 2392: Postsecondary Generative AI Standards and Training
snippet: California Assembly Bill 2392, which requests the University of California and requires CSU and community colleges to convene a joint working group to recommend AI procurement standards and training before providing GenAI systems, passed the Senate Appropriations suspense file on August 13, 2026.
